rules.statement: Only individuals with existing rights or those claiming an interest in the land may apply to be added as parties.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) Only persons who have rights or who are claiming an interest in the land can apply to be added as parties; added. The petitioners in any event have acquired their rights after the judgment was delivered. (2) Relief by way of Restitutio in integrum could not be granted as the petitioner had not been a party to the action. 394 Furthermore, there cannot be restitution as the petitioners could not be restored rights which they did not have at the time the judgment was entered. (3) The effect of non registration or improper registration of a Ms pendens on the finality of the interlocutory decree and the final decree under 48(3) of the Partition Act No. 16 of 1951 is no more in the Partition Law section No. 21 of 1977. The provisions in section 48(3) of the Partition Act states that the non registration or improper registration of a Us pendens is a ground of assailing the final and removed and is not available in the Partition Law No. 21 of 1977. (4) The resulting effect of the charge in the law is that non registration or improper registration of the lis pendens is no more a ground of challenge to the conclusive effect of the partition decree. (5) Petitioners are not without a remedy section 49(1)
